decisions.reason: The accelerator program has been featured on the home page in both years and costs little to run, so the visible commitment and small ongoing expense favor keeping it, though it is peripheral to the firm's manufacturing core.

The firm presents the CO2-negative bitumen binder as a flagship with its own page and has invested heavily in its R&D, so slow market uptake can still be blamed on long infrastructure adoption cycles and dropping it would expose the strategic bet as a mistake.

The infectious waste plant is a home-page flagship publicly tied to the ERMAFA partnership and framed as the start of a product line, so heavy investment and public commitment make its withdrawal very unlikely.
